title: Three questions, a denominator
hook: Two stated cases: explore the descriptive share behind a literacy score.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the descriptive share behind a literacy score affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Accuracy, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the descriptive share behind a literacy score in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
